description: A class whose `test*` methods are tests; assertion methods such as `assertEqual` report both values on failure.
A context manager that reports each row of a table separately and keeps the loop going after a failure.
Used as a context manager, it fails unless the block raises the given type and exposes the exception as `caught.exception`.
Replaces one attribute, named by a `"module.name"` string, with a `MagicMock` for a block or a test, then restores it.
Patch the name in the module that looks it up: after `from rates import fetch_rate`, that is `pricing.fetch_rate`.
Planting small bugs in the code to check that the suite fails on each; a surviving mutant marks a missing test.
